title: Design Day #17 Bangalore — Product Design
description:
The theme for March 2014 Design Day is:

PRODUCT DESIGN

Design Day is a curated platform for Designers to meet, discuss & solve problems together.

AGENDA:
1. Design Story by Sirnivas Kumar of Wizardry Studios: Srini is passionate about design and startups. He'll be sharing his journey as a product designer along with sharing how 2 products (one success and one failure) were designed.

2. A Skill Building Session by Narendra Ghate of Tata Elxsi: As the head of ID at Tata Elxsi, Narendra has strong observations for budding designers to learn from!

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 1.5 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

Cheers,
Team Design Day
